```sql
with fx as (
    select c.rate_date,
           c.currency,
           cast(c.usd_per_unit / r.usd_per_unit as decimal(38,12)) as to_reporting
    from fx_rates c
    join fx_rates r on r.rate_date = c.rate_date and r.currency = 'USD'
),
periods as (
    select 1 as period_order, 'last_month' as period_label,
           date '2026-08-01' as start_date, date '2026-08-31' as end_date
    union all
    select 2 as period_order, 'same_month_last_year' as period_label,
           date '2025-08-01' as start_date, date '2025-08-31' as end_date
),
captures as (
    select p.period_order,
           p.period_label,
           co.name as country_name,
           a.amount_minor,
           a.currency,
           a.business_date,
           row_number() over (
               partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
               order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
           ) as capture_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    join periods p
      on a.business_date between p.start_date and p.end_date
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    join countries co on co.country_code = s.country_code
    where a.status = 'captured'
      and not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
)
select cast(country_name || ' | ' || period_label as varchar) as key,
       cast(round(sum(c.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting)) as bigint) as value
from captures c
join fx on fx.currency = c.currency and fx.rate_date = c.business_date
where c.capture_rank = 1
group by country_name, period_order, period_label
order by country_name asc, period_order asc
```
